policy.approval: Only a human may add, change, or approve an entry (review_status: approved, human_reviewer set). Automation is limited to schema validation and to generating docs/prior-art.md. An entry with review_status pending is not citable outside this repository.
policy.temporal_relation: relation records a content relation only (anticipates / partial_overlap / adjacent / unresolved). Whether a source is earlier or later than a claim element is derived by the generator from the source's published date and the element's date_basis.date, and is never written by hand. A later source that fully describes an element is still recorded as anticipates when the element is not implemented here.
policy.comprehensive_search: last_comprehensive_search_at is set only when a human re-ran a documented search protocol for that element. last_candidate_triage_at moves whenever a candidate source was triaged against the element. No element may be described as first, novel, or independently converged unless last_comprehensive_search_at is set, the patent family is resolved, and the entry is approved.

sources.title: Agile V: A Compliance-Ready Framework for AI-Augmented Engineering -- From Concept to Audit-Ready Delivery
sources.note: Audit trail generated per task cycle, human-approval checkpoints. No cryptographic binding of evidence to artifacts described.

sources.note: Attestation-aware promotion gate (allow / quarantine / block). Names the lack of cryptographic binding between claims and artifacts as the core gap; the binding itself is not implemented.

sources.title: Agentic Agile-V: From Vibe Coding to Verified Engineering in Software and Hardware Development
sources.note: SCOPE-V loop, conversation-to-contract gate, evidence-bundle acceptance model. No digest binding described in the abstract.

sources.title: Meta-Engineering Harnesses for AI-Native Software Production: A Contract-Driven Adversarial Verification Architecture with Early Deployment Report
sources.note: Contract-driven, independent adversarial verification; four-way failure arbiter; outer-loop calibration; 17 features in production use.

sources.title: NovaFabric: Tamper-Evident, Replayable Evidence for Autonomous AI Agent Runs
sources.note: Tamper-evident, replayable evidence; proposal and approval linked by canonical digest; approver key distinct from proposer key.

sources.title: ZeroGate: Trust-Preserving Fast Paths for Governed AI Agent Runtimes
sources.note: Separates the admission receipt (approval record) from effect evidence (after the fact); observes that matching two old hashes does not answer whether the approval's premise still holds.

sources.title: From Agent Output to Authorized Transition (Agile-V Assurance Spine)
sources.note: Evidence bound to an authoritative source profile, exact artifact, and frozen policy baseline; freshness against declared dependencies; independence levels I0-I4 and authority matched to risk; gate verdicts recorded as receipts that carry approval references; approvals scoped and time-limited; re-check at merge / deploy / flash / release effect boundaries with single-use approval consumption. Cites only sources up to 2026-07; does not cite this repository.
